subject: Cross-provider repair: BonfyreReason must durably create the promised AgentSession state before success

body.observed_divergence: BonfyreReason start returned exit 0 and announced a session-state path, but exact filesystem readback found neither the session directory nor state.bfps. branch/run were correctly refused and not credited.
required_actions: Trace the actual cmd/BonfyreReason start path and identify why the promised durable session state is not materialized.
Make start fail closed unless the durable AgentSession state and required metadata are actually persisted and read back.
Bind physical state to the stable AgentSession identity rather than a transient PID/provider invocation.
Replay start -> exact state readback -> branch -> run under one stable AgentSession identity.
Add crash/restart replay: after process exit, the same session identity must recover from durable state without inventing a new logical session.
Emit ReceiptEnvelope evidence for state identity, event frontier, producer/provider identity and the readback witness; CLI exit 0 alone is not completion.
Run native/unit/control-plane tests and return either review_result with solved invariant or minimal trace_divergence.
body.regression_fence: No BonfyreReason start may report success unless the advertised durable session state exists and validates at the exact promised path/identity.
body.resource_policy: Prefer low-write repair/replay; do not download models or expand heavyweight state merely to prove session durability.
